observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show the same stainless-steel standing gas cooker with an oven compartment at the bottom and a hinged glass splashback at the top.
Cooktop has four burner positions: one appears to be a solid electric hotplate (dark coil disc, top-left in photo 0 and bottom-left in photo 1), the other three are gas burner caps.
Burner caps and grates show surface rust and discoloration, consistent with prior use, not a near-new item.
Lower storage/drawer panel is visibly scuffed and scratched with dents on the front panel in all three photos.
Five white control knobs are present and intact; no cracks or missing knobs visible.
Oven interior shows a wire rack, door appears intact with a working-looking hinge.
No brand nameplate, model sticker, or serial number is legible in any of the three photos.
No photo of a receipt, warranty card, flame test, or oven in use is provided.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standing gas cooker with visible wear (rust, scuffs) that contradicts the 'barely used' claim, and no functional proof (flame, oven heat) is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as a used, unverified-working standing cooker matching the cheaper end of comparable standing cooker listings.
